jobs.description: We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Financial Experience (FinXP), the team that builds how practices and patients deal with money at Nelly. That covers how a patient says yes to a treatment they can’t pay for upfront, and how delivered care becomes an invoice, then a payment, then cash in the practice’s account. You’ll lead a team whose work shows up directly in what practices earn and in what Nelly earns. The problem space: Practices rarely lose revenue because care isn’t needed. They lose it at two points. Before treatment, patients delay or decline because they can’t pay upfront. After treatment, revenue leaks on its way to cash: invoices go out late or wrong, payments get chased by hand, and billing runs through manual steps. The domain Financial OS closes both gaps. We offer financing at the moment the patient decides, through installment plans and factoring, and we turn every delivered treatment into a correct invoice and cash in the practice’s account. Because we sit where treatment is planned, we know what it’s worth and whether it is converted before we take on the risk, which no bank or payment provider can do. We earn a share of the revenue we help collect, so the practice’s growth is our growth. The domain has two teams. Financial Platform builds the infrastructure that moves money and keeps compliant records of it. Financial Experience builds everything doctors, practice staff, patients and our own teams touch, across the Doctor Portal, Patient Portal and Backoffice. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, and partners to bring event programs to life. You will manage the details, connect the teams, and make each experience feel useful, credible, and well run. What you’ll do here Plan and execute Coder’s EMEA event programs, including trade shows, conferences, summits, and partner activations. Manage event timelines, budgets, vendors, contracts, staffing plans, registration, logistics, shipping, and on-site execution. Partner with DevRel and Product Marketing to create event experiences that resonate with developers, platform engineers, DevOps teams, and technical buyers. Work with Sales to align event strategy to account priorities, meeting goals, pipeline creation, and follow-up motions. Create pre-event and post-event communications, including attendee outreach, internal briefings, speaker prep, staff guides, and follow-up plans. Coordinate Coder’s presence at open-source, developer, ai infrastructure, cloud, and platform engineering events. Help identify the right events for Coder to attend, sponsor, host, or skip based on audience fit, business goals, and community relevance. jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter (London)
jobs.description: Joining Coder as a Sr. Technical Recruiter is an opportunity to be a part of a high-impact, progressive, and collaborative team. We are trusted to represent Coder externally and guide all levels of the business in hiring decisions. You partner closely with hiring teams and candidates from the first conversation through handoff to the onboarding team. You balance speed and empathy, providing a tailored and consistent experience for both candidates and internal team members. What you’ll do here Own full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-technical roles, from intake through offer, while keeping candidate experience top of mind Source and engage candidates across multiple channels with creative, eye-catching outreach Manage hiring teams end-to-end, providing proactive communication and transparent feedback Track pipeline health, identify bottlenecks/challenges, and adjust strategy using data Maintain up-to-date documentation in Ashby, Notion, etc. to keep hiring teams aligned What we’re looking for 4+ years of experience recruiting for technical roles, with emphasis on Engineering, Product, and GTM Comfort discussing technical fundamentals, role expectations, and pitching Coder to candidates Strong partnership skills with hiring managers and cross‑functional teams Clear written and verbal communication; direct, respectful, and timely Organized approach to pipelines, prioritization, and competing deadlines Prior experience working in a startup environment and using Ashby ATS Bonus tacos if you have (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!) Substantial experience hiring for AI, developer tools, infrastructure, or open‑source teams Prior experience scaling a high-growth company Proactive approach to improving systems and processes for the team About Coder Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments.
